products.title: Bijur Delimon SureFire II Service Parts and Kits
products.descriptionShort: Bijur Delimon SureFire II Service Parts and Kits: 66 genuine part numbers for the SureFire II single-phase and three-phase pumps, including motors and gearmotors, valves and solenoids, and level and pressure switches. Order by Bijur Delimon part number or send the pump type plate. From Indus Hydraulics, authorised Bijur Delimon distributor for the Middle East, supplied direct from the manufacturer.
products.descriptionLong:
Genuine Bijur Delimon service parts for the SureFire II single-phase and three-phase pumps: the 66 part numbers Bijur Delimon lists for them, covering motors and gearmotors (16); valves and solenoids (14); level and pressure switches (11); reservoirs and covers (10); controllers and electrical parts (6); and pump elements and pistons (5). SureFire II is Bijur Delimon's self-contained, electric motor-driven gear pump for automatic oil and fluid-grease lubrication of production machinery. One pump serves up to about 100 lubrication points.

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Bijur Delimon distributor for the Middle East and supplies genuine parts and kits direct from the manufacturer, with the maker's parts lists and service documents.

What the list covers

  • Motors and gearmotors — 16 part numbers (for example 71106, 71111-12, 71111-2, 71111-6)
  • Valves and solenoids — 14 part numbers (for example 70678, 71023, 71057, 71071)
  • Level and pressure switches — 11 part numbers (for example 71029, 71119, 71120, 71124-12)
  • Reservoirs and covers — 10 part numbers (for example 70745, 71064, 71114, 71247)
  • Controllers and electrical parts — 6 part numbers (for example 60726, 71110, 71123-L, 71123-P)
  • Pump elements and pistons — 5 part numbers (for example 25937-1, 25937-2, 25960-1, 71128)
  • Gauges and indicators — 2 part numbers (71129, 71130)
  • Filters and strainers — 1 part number (71121)

Finding the right part

Start from the pump: its model and part number are on the type plate, and the parts list in its manual or service card (in the Downloads tab) gives the item number of each part. Match that to the Bijur Delimon part number in the table — the For column says which pump or pump version Bijur Delimon lists each part under. If the plate is unreadable, send us a photo of the pump and of the worn part and we identify it with the manufacturer before quoting.

Row descriptions are Bijur Delimon's own, in its shorthand: RES reservoir, ASSY assembly, LLS low-level switch, TBG tubing, ADPT adapter, CONN connector, SP-Kit or ET-Kit spare-part kit, and the thread as published (NPT, BSPP, M-thread).

What wears and what to keep on site

On an electric lubricator the parts that need replacing are the ones that see the lubricant and the weather: the reservoir gasket and filler-cap filter, suction and in-line filters, the relief valve and the pump-element seals, and the level switch and cable glands that keep moisture out of the motor housing. In Gulf plants dust and heat shorten those intervals, so a seal kit, a set of filters and a spare level switch are worth holding on site; a motor or gear pump is an overhaul part, ordered when the pump is opened up.

The pump

The complete pumps are on their own pages: Bijur Delimon SureFire II Single-Phase Lubrication Pumps (SLR and PDI), Bijur Delimon SureFire II Three-Phase Lubrication Pumps, Bijur Delimon SureFire II PDI Lubricators with ZEM Injectors (71800 and SFX71322) and Bijur Delimon SureFire II M12 and DIN Connectors and Cables, with their part numbers, data and documents. When a pump is beyond repair we quote the replacement unit alongside the parts.

Documents

Bijur Delimon's manuals and datasheets for this range are in the Downloads tab.

products.descriptionLong:
Genuine Bijur Delimon service parts for the L13 manual PDI lubricator: the 13 part numbers Bijur Delimon lists for it, covering fittings and tubing (9); reservoirs and covers (3); and filters and strainers (1). Single-action hand pumps for positive-displacement injector and progressive systems.

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Bijur Delimon distributor for the Middle East and supplies genuine parts and kits direct from the manufacturer, with the maker's parts lists and service documents.

What the list covers

  • Fittings and tubing — 9 part numbers (for example 15322, 15326, 22545, 22585-2)
  • Reservoirs and covers — 3 part numbers (25093-1, 25093-2, 25093-5)
  • Filters and strainers — 1 part number (30033)

Finding the right part

Start from the pump: its model and part number are on the type plate, and the parts list in its manual or service card (in the Downloads tab) gives the item number of each part. Match that to the Bijur Delimon part number in the table. If the plate is unreadable, send us a photo of the pump and of the worn part and we identify it with the manufacturer before quoting.

Row descriptions are Bijur Delimon's own, in its shorthand: RES reservoir, ASSY assembly, LLS low-level switch, TBG tubing, ADPT adapter, CONN connector, SP-Kit or ET-Kit spare-part kit, and the thread as published (NPT, BSPP, M-thread).

What wears and what to keep on site

A manual lubricator has few wearing parts: the reservoir gasket or seal, the fill screen or filter, the check valves and the piston seal. A spare reservoir assembly and a filter group cover most repairs.

The pump

The complete pumps are on their own page: Bijur Delimon Manual PDI and Progressive Lubricators (L13, L3, L6P, L100P, Lubri-Trak), with their part numbers, data and documents. When a pump is beyond repair we quote the replacement unit alongside the parts.

Documents

Bijur Delimon's datasheets for this range are in the Downloads tab.
